newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-STEWART LAUNCH NEW FORMULA ONE CAR.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-STEWART LAUNCH NEW FORMULA ONE CAR.

text.p: Formula One newcomers Stewart-Ford unveiled their tartan-painted car, believed to be the first vehicle designed and created entirely by computer, in London on Tuesday.
The launch of the car, the first 1997 machine to be launched by any team, came less than a year after the team's inception in Detroit in January this year.

"This car has been built without the use of drawing boards and is the first, we believe, to have been designed and created completely by computer," said team chief Paul Stewart, who was accompanied his father, three times world champion Jackie Stewart at the launch.
The car is painted white with flashes of the Stewart family tartan.
The team's drivers for the 1997 season, which opens in Melbourne on March 9, will be Brazilian Rubens Barrichello and Denmark's Jan Magnussen.
